full_judgment: 79. If the employees of projects under the government are held to be barred from applying to the Administrative Tribunal for not being in the service of the Republic, even then there should not be any difficulty to invoke jurisdiction of civil courts unless in a statute there is any ouster clause like section 14A of (Emergency) Requisition of property Act, 1948, section 44 of the Emergency Requisition Ordinance, 1982, section 30 of SAT Act, 1950, section 45 of the Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1961 and so on. For mere violation of any contractual right as to absorption after completion of projects, or on the ground that they continued to be employed in the project under government based on its promise to eventually include in the revenue set up and thereby having legitimate expectation thereto, or violation of any Law or Rule can well be dealt with by the civil courts unless they intend to challenge any vires of law or raise a clear case of violation of fundamental right for which they are to seek judicial review under Article 102 of the Constitution.
